suggestions: I'm grateful for a migration script that ran clean on the first attempt, no 2am panic.
I'm thankful for the mosque car park having space when I show up two minutes before Isha.
I'm grateful for a flat white at the office that somehow tastes better than the overpriced one downstairs.
I'm thankful for my sister sending a meme at exactly the moment I needed to stop staring at a stack trace.
I'm grateful for a PR that got approved with just a thumbs up and nothing else to fix.
I'm thankful for the quiet of the house when I wake up early enough to actually sit for a bit before Subuh.
I'm grateful for a manager who said 'go home, we'll fix it tomorrow' and meant it.
I'm thankful for finding RM20 in an old jacket pocket right before payday.
I'm grateful for a bug report with actual reproduction steps instead of just 'it's broken'.
I'm thankful for the roti canai guy remembering I take mine kosong, no questions asked.
I'm grateful for a cloud bill that came in under budget for once.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's voice note reminding me to drink water, as if I'm still ten.
I'm grateful for traffic that actually moved on the way back from Friday prayers.
I'm thankful for a junior dev who caught an edge case I completely missed.
I'm grateful for a rainy Saturday with absolutely nothing on the calendar.
